title: Death in the Clinic
summary: One of the patients at an exclusive clinic is found drowned. Suicide is suspected as she was known to be depressed.
method: The victim was unwittingly injected with an overdose of Botox which led to a full body paralysis and death. Her body was dumped in the pool.
motive: The victim stumbled upon the clinic’s illegal activities, which involved assigning new identities to its criminal clients.
killer: The general manager of the clinic
